title: The Girl From The Farm — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Spanish Italian language learning warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia character portrait honest practical
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She grew up where distances are real.
She helped in the dairy before school.
She knew which cow needed watching before the cow knew.
Red dust in Australia — still on her shoes somehow.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Creció donde las distancias son reales. (She grew up where distances are real.)
Ayudaba en la lechería antes de la escuela. (She helped in the dairy before school.)
Sabía qué vaca necesitaba vigilancia antes que la vaca misma. (She knew which cow needed watching before the cow knew.)
Polvo rojo en Australia — todavía en sus zapatos de alguna manera. (Red dust in Australia — still on her shoes somehow.)
La chica de la granja (The girl from the farm)
Ahora la mujer con la familia. (Now the woman with the family.)
Que trajo Zimbabue a Australia. (Who brought Zimbabwe to Australia.)
Kerri — exactamente así. (Kerri — exactly that.)

[Chorus - Italian, with English translations]
La ragazza della fattoria (The girl from the farm)
Ora la donna con la famiglia (Now the woman with the family)
La ragazza della fattoria (The girl from the farm)
Che ha portato lo Zimbabwe in Australia (Who brought Zimbabwe to Australia)
La ragazza della fattoria (The girl from the farm)
Kerri — che viene da Jeff e Jill (Kerri — who came from Jeff and Jill)
Cresciuta nella certezza della polvere rossa (Who grew up in the red dust certainty)
Ed è ancora esattamente così (And is still exactly that)

[Bridge - all three]
English: You can trace the line back. It goes straight. It always goes straight with this family.
Spanish: Puedes rastrear la línea hacia atrás. Va directo. Siempre va directo con esta familia. (You can trace the line. It goes straight. Always straight with this family.)
Italian: Puoi tracciare la linea all'indietro. Va dritta. Va sempre dritta con questa famiglia. (You can trace the line. It goes straight. Always straight with this family.)

[Outro - all three]
English: The girl from the farm is home now
Spanish: La chica de la granja está en casa ahora (The girl from the farm is home now)
Italian: La ragazza della fattoria è a casa ora (The girl from the farm is home now)
